content: HTTP Range partial download: Request.Builder().header(Range, bytes=<offset>-) -> 206 Partial Content; plain 200 means server ignores ranges -> restart from 0 and truncate file. Optional If-Range (ETag/date) guards against changed resource on resume. OkHttp: stream response.body.byteStream() to RandomAccessFile seeking offset; cancellation via call.cancel(); timeouts via client config.
